source.name: SportsPro – 'Columbus Crew score US$3m a year Nationwide shirt deal from 2021'
source.quote: the club are reportedly set to earn more than US$3 million per season from the deal, according to the Columbus Dispatch.

note: Multi-year jersey partnership beginning in 2021; Nationwide remains the front sponsor on the 2026-27 home kit. The figure is a Columbus Dispatch report cited by SportsPro, and the article says 'more than US$3 million per season', so it is a floor rather than a cap. In 2026 Nationwide also agreed to buy a reported 37% stake in the Crew's ownership group (Sportico, 29 May 2026; club/PR Newswire announcement, 25 June 2026) — a club-ownership fact, not a shirt deal.
